from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowMetric(BaseModel):
    """A single line item from a cash flow statement found in a document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as it appears in the document")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the statement covers (e.g. '2022', '2023')")
    line_item_name: str | None = Field(description="The specific cash flow line item (e.g. 'Net increase in cash', 'Net cash used in operating activities')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value reported; positive for inflow, negative for outflow if signed")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim text snippet containing the amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_metrics: list[CashFlowMetric]
